apps.name: Nova Launcher
apps.whats_new: The Store is catalog-driven now: every app published to the online store gets a row here — including brand-new apps like Nova House Log — with Install or Update decided by the version actually on your phone. Before this fix the store only ever listed the seven apps baked in when it shipped, so new apps never appeared and their updates never showed. The catalog check is also cache-busted, so a freshly published app shows up on the first check, not a later one.

apps.name: Nova Voice
apps.whats_new: Engine registration fix: Nova Voice now answers Android's engine-data checks (voice data check, sample text, install data) the way Google and Samsung's engines do — through 1.9 nothing answered those probes, and Nova never appeared in the Preferred engine lists. The app's top line now shows version 2.0 so you can confirm the update landed.

apps.name: Nova Phone
apps.whats_new: Speaker fix: speaker and mute now switch on the Telecom audio route itself, and Nova only says "Speaker on" once the call stack confirms it. Plus an in-call keypad for business phone menus and a one-tap Call Computer Revolution button on the Dialer tab.

apps.name: Nova Chat
apps.whats_new: Fixes the blank screen — the app now actually shows the Watch List and Chat Reader.

apps.name: Nova Stream
apps.whats_new: Stream from the phone with RTMP — Twitch and YouTube starter buttons.

apps.name: UHC Claim Builder
apps.whats_new: Receipt fix: when Uber's receipt email has no PDF attached (most don't — the receipt is in the email body), the app now builds the receipt PDF from the email itself, so Gmail trips land with a receipt you can actually claim with. And on the next Gmail pull, trips you already pulled that are missing a receipt get one fixed on them automatically.

apps.name: Fanciful Companion
apps.whats_new: Fanciful now borrows the Gemini key from the Launcher instead of asking you to paste it again, and no longer pops the key dialog up on its own.

apps.name: Nova House Log
apps.whats_new: The save gate: an entry now ONLY saves once Skye was actually told — in person, by a direct text/message, or in the house group chat — with what was said and her response on record (there's a "She didn't respond" button, so a stonewall still counts). Telling someone else no longer counts. New fields property management acts on: lease category chips (noise/quiet hours, guests, mess, safety, damage, harassment, smoking, parking, other), where it happened, impact, evidence pointers, a REPEAT AFTER NOTICE flag when she'd been told about that kind of thing before, and a follow-up status. Reports are now timelines, oldest first, with a summary block (counted incidents, date range, repeats after notice, category breakdown) and a plain closing request for a meeting. Older entries that were never raised with her stay visible as NOT COUNTED and move to a clearly labeled appendix — they no longer inflate the totals.
